topic: the edgelesssys/reproducible-mkosi project: reproducible mkosi builds, its techniques, and prior art for reproducible OS image verification

subtopics.scope: What edgelesssys/reproducible-mkosi is: a 2023 Edgeless Systems demo of bit-for-bit reproducible OS images via mkosi plus Nix, its repository layout, frozen status since 2024-02-07, and adoption signals.
seed_queries: edgeless systems reproducible mkosi repository status frozen

subtopics.scope: The catalogue of techniques that make the builds deterministic: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0, fixed repart seed, sorted cpio input, CleanPackageMetadata, RemoveFiles, and the upstream mkosi/systemd/dosfstools/authselect PRs Edgeless authored.
seed_queries: mkosi reproducible build SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH systemd-repart fixed seed
mkosi reproducible image techniques sorted cpio RemoveFiles upstream PRs

subtopics.scope: The diffimage.sh two-build verifier pattern: build twice, systemd-dissect --mtree, DPS-aware partition extraction, sha256 plus veritysetup dump diffing, and exit-on-divergence design.
seed_queries: mkosi diffimage.sh two build reproducibility verifier systemd-dissect mtree
verify reproducible OS image build compare two builds veritysetup sha256

subtopics.scope: Nix-pinned build toolchain via flake.nix: why pinning the build environment matters, the mkosi commit pin, and empirical evidence for Nix reproducibility rates.
seed_queries: nix flake pinned toolchain reproducible mkosi builds
nix reproducibility empirical study package reproducibility rate

subtopics.scope: The single e2e.yml CI workflow: daily rebuild-and-diff cron, nix flake update as a moving target, un-archived live distro mirrors, and what reproducibility is actually achieved.
seed_queries: github actions daily reproducible build verification cron workflow_dispatch
reproducible builds CI moving target package archive distro mirrors

subtopics.scope: The absence of a signing and attestation chain in the repo (no SecureBoot keys, cosign, in-toto, SLSA) and the Edgeless philosophy that reproducibility substitutes for trust in the signer.
seed_queries: cosign in-toto SBOM attestation container images edgeless constellation
reproducible builds versus signing trust remote attestation confidential computing

subtopics.scope: Direct peers and failed attempts: Flashbots mkosi-poc, Jelly arch-mkosi-boxes, repro-get deprecation, mkosi #1115 --reproduce, btrfs reproducibility dead end.
seed_queries: flashbots mkosi-poc reproducible builds intel tdx
mkosi reproducible arch linux btrfs reproducibility problems

subtopics.scope: Academic and community foundations: IEEE Software 2021 reproducible builds framing, verifiable builds research, and the reproducible-builds.org Debian lineage.
seed_queries: reproducible builds IEEE Software 2021 academic paper

subtopics.scope: Edgeless versus yubiOS: overlap matrix, what yubiOS already implements (commit-derived epoch, fork pinning, multi-surface verifiers), what is complementary, and borrow guidance.
seed_queries: bootc image mode reproducible OCI OS image verification
YubiKey PIV secure boot signing mkosi UKI dm-verity roothash
